title: The Fabled Master of the Guard
summary: The fabled Master of the Guard uses the paired-sentry sequence in Sleep Walking.
overview: The fabled Master of the Guard uses the paired-sentry sequence in Sleep Walking.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign add tanks for each pair while maintaining control of the Master.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first sentry pair activates three seconds after engagement.
Three further pairs activate at 50-second intervals.
Five minutes out of combat restores the sentry formation; the fabled death callback records the expedition boss lockout.

notes: Approval E291. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
